text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the billing postmortem — trying to close the loop on remediation owners and dates. TL;DR: we have an outstanding invoice correction batch and a recurring ingestion pattern to address.

ken: thanks — can you paste the current action list?

maya: sure. high level: 1) run corrected token re-ingest for affected window (owner: arjun, due: 2026-04-02) 2) run invoice reissue + notify affected accounts (owner: sara, due: 2026-04-07) 3) instrument ingest alert for delayed batches to prevent recurrence (owner: ken, due: 2026-03-31) 4) compensation playbook draft (owner: eli, due: 2026-04-05)

arjun: I started the re-ingest dry-run earlier today. found two msg types that need special handling (multipart prompts and truncated kv-cache). working on a filter to avoid duplicates. ETA 24h.

sara: for reissue, finance needs PR #412 applied to ledger fixes first. can we get a toggle to pause reissues for accounts that already got provisional credits?

ken: ops-bot flagged the recurring pattern in ingestion: backfill jobs sometimes stall when upstream GC spikes. I linked a trace in the incident ticket. plan: add a watchdog to restart stalled jobs after 10m and emit a high-sev metric.

ops-bot: [automated] incident 2026-03-20-0922 attached: trace_id=tr_7f3a. Current stalled-job-count=8.

eli: working on the compensation playbook draft now. proposal: prorated credits for customers with >1% variance and automatic one-time credit for <100 affected accounts. will include messaging templates.

maya: noted. two cross-team asks: (A) eng to produce a short runbook for the re-ingest (arjun + ken) so finance can validate entries before reissue; (B) legal/comm to review templates (sara -> comms).

arjun: I will add the runbook as a small markdown in the runbooks repo and ping here. snippet of the reingest command: 
```
./reingest --window 2026-03-01:2026-03-08 --dedupe-mode=hash+ts 
```
we also have a dry-run flag `--preview-only` that produces a CSV for finance review.

sara: thanks — pls include the exact CSV schema so accounting can map fields.

ken: I'll add the watchdog + metric today and send a dashboard link. can someone own the postmortem action tracker update?

maya: I'll own the tracker update and weekly status note. plan to post a short summary in #finance each Friday until closed.

eli: draft compensation playbook will be in my fork by EOD tomorrow.

maya: great. last ask: if anyone finds edge cases during the re-ingest dry-run, reply here with the sample id and short note (no PII). we'll triage and adjust filters. :thumbsup:

ken: ack

arjun: ack

sara: ack

maya: closing out — next check-in scheduled: 2026-03-27 10:00 PT (sync call). I'll post calendar invite.

ops-bot: [automated reminder] follow-up: owner=maya, milestone=weekly-status, next=2026-03-27T17:00:00Z
